product_family: Compass AI is an AI-powered financial operating system for fractional CFOs, CPA firms, and small-to-mid-sized businesses ($500K–$20M revenue). Integrates with QuickBooks, Xero, FreshBooks for automated cash flow forecasting, custom dashboards, and financial analysis. Founded 2024, 9 employees, early-stage startup.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 1
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of SOC 2 certification; privacy policy and terms make no reference to SOC 2 audit.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of SOC 2 Type 2 certification; no trust center or audit report found on vendor domain.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of ISO 27001 in privacy policy, terms, or security documentation on vendor domain.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy Policy states Compass 'treats such personal data adequately and in compliance with the relevant regulations' and adheres to GDPR framework; data processors include GDPR-regulated entities (AWS Germany, Salt Edge UK, Plaid Netherlands).

certifications.name: CCPA / CPRA
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy Policy explicitly states compliance with CCPA/CPRA and state-level privacy laws (Virginia CDPA, Colorado Privacy Act, Nevada statute).

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of HIPAA in privacy policy or terms. Product is designed for financial/accounting use, not healthcare; not in scope.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of PCI DSS in privacy policy or terms. No evidence of payment card processing or PCI compliance.

privacy.ai_training_note: No mention of training on customer data in privacy policy or terms. Standard disclaimers on use of service 'as is' with encryption and backups mentioned but no data processing for model improvement stated.
privacy.data_region: Multi-region processing (AWS Germany, Salt Edge UK, Plaid Netherlands, Ars Futura Croatia, Along Peopleware Croatia). No explicit data residency commitment or EU-only guarantee stated.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: Terms state 'We enforce encryption for data transmission from the public Internet.' The specific protocol (e.g. TLS) and version are not disclosed.

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: Mentions 'backups, redundancies, and encryption' but no specific algorithm or AES standard disclosed.

security.name: Data Processors
security.value: Five identified processors: Ars Futura d.o.o. (Croatia), Amazon Web Services (Germany), Salt Edge Limited (UK), Plaid B.V. (Netherlands), Along Peopleware d.o.o. (Croatia).

security.name: Third-Party Audit / Certifications
security.value: No third-party SOC 2, ISO 27001, or equivalent audit mentioned. Marketing claims 'Bank-level security' without verification.

products.name: Compass AI (Core Platform)
products.data_scope: Connects to QuickBooks, Xero, FreshBooks, and bank accounts for multi-entity financial data consolidation, forecasting, and reporting.
products.notes: Targets fractional CFOs, CPA firms, and small-to-mid-sized businesses. No healthcare, no HIPAA. Pricing and exact feature tiers not detailed in public security/compliance docs.

compare.pricing_model: Unknown; product is subscription-based SaaS for financial intelligence (specifics not in security/legal pages).
compare.data_residency: Multi-region (EU processors in Germany, UK, Netherlands; EEA-adjacent processing in Croatia). No exclusive EU residency guarantee; no public data localization commitment.

flags: VENDOR MISIDENTIFICATION: Original evidence (compass.com) is a real estate brokerage, not Compass AI. Assessment corrected to reflect compassapp.ai (Financial Intelligence Platform, founded 2024).
STARTUP MATURITY: Company founded in 2024 with 9 employees and $564K funding. No security certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA) held or publicly claimed.
OVER-CLAIM: Marketing copy claims 'Bank-level security' without third-party audit evidence or SOC 2 certification to back it.
DPA NOT MENTIONED: Privacy policy states 'appropriate agreements with Compass' exist with processors but no Data Processing Agreement is publicly available or linked.
DATA RESIDENCY AMBIGUOUS: Multi-region processing confirmed but no explicit EU-only guarantee or GDPR Adequacy/Standard Contractual Clause detail in public docs.

ENCRYPTION STANDARDS NOT SPECIFIED: Encryption is mentioned for data in transit and for stored data, but no protocol (e.g. TLS), version, algorithm (e.g. AES-256), or key management detail is disclosed.
NO DATA BREACH POLICY: Terms do not detail breach notification procedures, timelines, or regulatory reporting (GDPR Article 33, CCPA Section 1798.150).
